jobs.name: Urzeit-Lichtung
jobs.subject: A sunny clearing in a prehistoric jungle: a wide flat grassy ground, palm trees and ferns at the left and right edges, a small volcano far away on the horizon. The lower two thirds of the picture are calm, flat and almost empty so that toys can be placed there; details only along the top and the edges. No animals, no people, nothing in the middle.

jobs.name: Straße mit Kreuzung
jobs.subject: A quiet town street seen from the side: a wide flat grey road across the lower half with a white dashed centre line and a zebra crossing at the left, a pavement with a street lamp, and along the top a row of small colourful houses with plain doors, square windows and tiled roofs between round green trees. The lower two thirds of the picture are calm and almost empty so that toys can be placed there. Nothing stands on the road.

jobs.name: Auf dem Mond
jobs.subject: The surface of the moon: wide flat grey ground with a few small craters at the edges, a black sky with stars and the blue planet Earth small in one top corner. The lower two thirds of the picture are calm, flat and almost empty so that toys can be placed there; details only along the top and the edges. No animals, no people, nothing in the middle.

jobs.name: Bausteinplatte
jobs.subject: A big green toy building baseplate with rows of round studs lying on a wooden playroom floor, seen from the front slightly from above, a toy shelf far in the background along the top. The lower two thirds of the picture are calm, flat and almost empty so that toys can be placed there; details only along the top and the edges. No animals, no people, nothing in the middle.

jobs.name: Baustelle
jobs.subject: A construction site: a wide flat sandy ground, a pile of sand and a stack of bricks at the left edge, a wooden site fence and a half-built brick house with scaffolding along the top, blue sky. The lower two thirds of the picture are calm, flat and almost empty so that toys can be placed there; details only along the top and the edges. No animals, no people, nothing in the middle.

jobs.name: Bauernhof
jobs.subject: A farm: a wide flat green meadow with a brown field strip, a red barn, a silo and a wooden fence along the top, round trees at the edges, blue sky. The lower two thirds of the picture are calm, flat and almost empty so that toys can be placed there; details only along the top and the edges. No animals, no people, nothing in the middle.

jobs.name: Bahngleise
jobs.subject: A railway line seen from the side: one straight railway track with wooden sleepers runs across the picture in the lower third on flat green ground, a small station building with a platform and a signal along the top, hills behind. The lower two thirds of the picture are calm, flat and almost empty so that toys can be placed there; details only along the top and the edges. No animals, no people, nothing in the middle.

jobs.name: Hafen
jobs.subject: A harbour: calm flat blue water fills the lower two thirds, a stone quay with a red and white lighthouse and stacked colourful containers along the top, blue sky with small clouds. The lower two thirds of the picture are calm, flat and almost empty so that toys can be placed there; details only along the top and the edges. No animals, no people, nothing in the middle.

jobs.name: Himmel
jobs.subject: A wide open blue sky that fills almost the whole picture, a few soft white clouds near the top corners, and far below at the very bottom a thin strip of green hills and tiny roofs. The middle of the picture is calm and empty so that toys can be placed there. No animals, no people, no aircraft.

jobs.name: Spielzimmer
jobs.subject: A playroom floor seen from the front: a big flat plain green play mat lies on a wooden floor and fills the lower two thirds, a few colourful plastic toy construction bricks with round studs lie at the left and right edges, a low toy shelf with boxes along the top wall. The lower two thirds of the picture are calm, flat and almost empty so that toys can be placed there; details only along the top and the edges. No animals, no people, nothing in the middle.
